title: [CQ-M07n3] Seat VM and per-task seat job, happy path (moe-agent.ps1)
description:
SPIDR split out of CQ-M07n (task-62ec51f179494706a39045154d07e544) by architect-30d804be on 2026-11-01. This is the PowerShell twin of CQ-M07m3 (task-3954cc09): the happy path. CQ-M07n keeps the error paths. Chain: mem:task-task-62ec51f179494706a39045154d07e544-handoff and mem:task-task-828e7d21602e4cf2a0f242e024db7dea-handoff.

**Depends on:**
- CQ-M07m3 (task-3954cc09). Its landed moe-agent.sh code is the source of every string, of the order of the steps and of the stub seam. Port it; never re-derive it. Through it come CQ-M07i (seat-start/seat-stop), CQ-M07j (seat-job), CQ-M07q (the claim marker) and CQ-M07k (vm-credential). Their contracts are in that row's description.
- CQ-M07n2 (task-d861f3de): the same files, and it provides the ps1 landing function.

**Objective.** Under verified-local and ready (CQ-M07n1's gate), a worker or QA seat of moe-agent.ps1 never runs its agent CLI on the host. It is the route the JetBrains launcher (CQ-M07o) uses on Windows.

**Deliverable.** In scripts/moe-agent.ps1, with rows in scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1:
- **Seat start.** Run seat-start once, before the iteration's claim, when the seat holds no VM. Keep the instance for the whole wrapper pass.
  - Pass `--runner $script:MoeProcessStartedAt --host $script:MoeHost`, each as ONE argument.
  - Anything but ok refuses fail-closed, with CQ-M07m3's MOE_SEAT_START_FAILED line and exit 1.
- **Claim.** On VM-route iterations only, claim with `executionRoute = 'vm'` added to a per-iteration COPY of $claimRpcArgs, at both claim sites (the pre-flight claim and the single-shot wait's re-claims). A legacy iteration never carries it.
- **Post-claim backstop.** If the claim's workspace mode ($script:MoeWtMode) is not 'worktree', refuse with MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED before any job.
- **Job.** A new branch of the launch dispatch, before codex/gemini/grok/claude, runs `node <agent-seat> seat-job …` in place of the host CLI.
  - claude: the token comes from `Invoke-MoeAccountHelper vm-credential $script:AccountLeasedId`. It is wrapped as JSON {name, value} and piped to seat-job's stdin (`$json | & node …`), never as an argv, an env, a file or a log line.
  - Every seat-* spawn runs with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY and CODEX_API_KEY removed from the environment, restored in a finally, because the in-process supervisor keeps env across passes.
  - codex, and a missing token, fail closed here as CQ-M07m3 does; CQ-M07n adds the rest.
- **Outcome.** Relay the job's output. Parse the last stdout line marked "seatJob":1, and keep stderr records (5.1 ErrorRecords) apart from stdout lines.
  - The outcome's exitCode becomes $script:CliExitCode.
  - A worker's admitted tree goes through CQ-M07n2's function, then the normal post-flight.
  - QA lands nothing of its own.
- **Seat stop.** The outer finally runs seat-stop whenever the seat holds a VM, before Invoke-MoeDeregister. It is best-effort and bounded. That one funnel covers normal exit, Ctrl+C, terminating errors, `exit` and the hot-reload hand-over.
- **Placeholder and seam.**
  - Remove CQ-M07n1's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_VM_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE placeholder.
  - Add CQ-M07m3's MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH stub seam, ignored when $script:MoeRuntimeProtected is set.
- **PowerShell 5.1 and 7.** Relax $ErrorActionPreference around native stderr. Check that seat-job's stdin reader accepts the trailing newline PowerShell's pipe appends; if it does not, write stdin through a System.Diagnostics.Process with RedirectStandardInput instead. Keep moe-agent.ps1 UTF-8 with a BOM.

**NOT in scope:**
- the capacity wait, seat-start failure details, codex credentials, missing-token escalation, a failed job and the hot-reload row (CQ-M07n);
- landing internals (CQ-M07n2);
- moe-agent.sh;
- the daemon.

**Verification.** Run from WSL (mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl, mem:gotcha-pwsh7-reachable-from-wsl):
- `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\postflight-vm-route.ps1`, then the same with pwsh.exe;
- then `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\postflight.ps1` with MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180;
- then `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`.
definitionOfDone: verified-local and ready, claude worker: the host CLI stub never runs; the agent-seat stub records seat-start, then seat-job, then seat-stop at exit, and the claim carries executionRoute 'vm' (row).
That worker job's admitted tree lands through CQ-M07n2's function onto moe/task/<id> (row).
A canary token from the vm-credential stub reaches seat-job only on stdin: it is absent from every recorded argv and env and from all wrapper output, under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7 (row).
seat-stop runs on a normal exit and on Ctrl+C sent mid-job with GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent, as postflight.ps1's interrupt supervisor sends it (rows).
A claim whose workspace is shared refuses MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED with no seat-job, and MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH is ignored under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 (rows).

postflight-vm-route.ps1 passes alone under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7, postflight.ps1 passes under Windows PowerShell 5.1, bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes, and moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM.
taskRails: Never fall back to running the agent CLI on the host under verified-local.
Legacy stays byte-for-byte unchanged in behavior.
Port CQ-M07m3's landed behavior and strings verbatim; a credential never enters an argv, an env, a file or a log.

implementationPlan.description:
Port sources first, then the rows (tests first).

**PORT SOURCES (never re-derive).**
- CQ-M07m3's own last commit, never HEAD (CQ-M07m later edits the same code): `git log -1 --format=%H moe/work-2026-10-24 --grep 'Moe-Task: task-3954cc09f74045a0ac8fa4b795dcb0a9' -- scripts/moe-agent.sh`.
  - `git show <sha>:scripts/moe-agent.sh`: the seat route (seam, seat-start, the claim marker, the post-claim backstop, the seat-job branch, credential piping, outcome parse, landing call, seat-stop in cleanup_temp).
  - `git show <sha>:scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.sh`: its rows and its agent-seat stub.
  - The landed sh text wins over this plan.
- The landed agent-seat CLI, scripts/local-runner/agent-seat.mjs (CQ-M07i/j); read its header.
  - `seat-start --project <abs> --worker <id> --runner <pid@token> --host <host>`
  - `seat-stop` adds `--instance <moe-vm-...>`
  - `seat-job --project --worker --runner --host --instance --role worker|qa --task --attempt --generation --checkout <abs> --commit <full id> --cli claude|codex`, in fixed order
  - Each prints ONE JSON line. Exit 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage; seat-start also 75 for capacity.
  - seat-job reads the credential ONLY from stdin as one JSON {name, value}, to EOF, at most 16 KiB. It relays the job's stdout/stderr bytes and ends with one stdout line carrying "seatJob":1 plus runSeatJob's result: {ok:true, role, commit, baseTree, tree, exitCode, ...} or {ok:false, code, vm}.
- CQ-M07n2's Invoke-MoeVmCandidateLanding($Commit, $BaseTree, $Tree, $M), with $M = @{TaskId; Title; Status; ReopenCount; CliExit; Sid}, returning @{Rc; Outcome; Code; ...}.
- CQ-M07n1's gate and row helper in scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1.

**ROWS**, in scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1. n1 created it and n2 extended it; it sits under newFiles only because it did not exist at planning time. EXTEND it, never recreate it. Port m3's rows one for one, as a `[vm seat]` section reusing n1's helper (fixture, fake CLIs, call log, FAKE_READINESS) and n2's worktree fixture.
- **Agent-seat stub** (node), selected by MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH exactly as m3's stub is. It records each invocation's subcommand, argv, env and (seat-job only) stdin bytes to a log, answers m3's JSON, and exits 0.
- **V1 (DoD 1).** verified-local and ready; a worktree claim (FAKE_CLAIM_WORKSPACE as m3 sets it); worker + the claude fake.
  - The host CLI fake never runs.
  - The stub log is seat-start, then seat-job, then seat-stop at exit.
  - Every claim_next_task in the call log carries executionRoute 'vm'. That covers both claim sites when m3 has a row for the single-shot wait's re-claim (port it).
  - A legacy T row from n1 still claims WITHOUT the key.
- **V2 (DoD 2).** The stub's seat-job writes a real tree object into W's repository and answers ok with that commit, baseTree and tree. Afterwards refs/heads/moe/task/<id> is one new commit with that tree and parent `commit`, landed through Invoke-MoeVmCandidateLanding.
- **V3 (DoD 3).** Rotation on, with m3's account fixture: MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE and FAKE_ACCOUNT_HOME as the [accounts] rows do. The leased account's VM token file holds a canary matching `^sk-ant-oat\d{2}-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$`.
  - The canary reaches the stub ONLY in seat-job's stdin JSON.
  - It is absent from every recorded argv and env, from all wrapper output, and from every file under the run's project and temp dirs except the token store itself (task rail: no file or log).
  - The whole harness runs on both engines, so this covers 5.1 and 7.
- **V4 (DoD 4).** seat-stop is recorded on a normal exit (V1), and on Ctrl+C sent mid-job.
  - The stub's seat-job writes a ready marker, then sleeps.
  - Run the wrapper through a supervisor copied from postflight.ps1's frozen-suite interrupt supervisor: Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden; wait for the marker; FreeConsole, AttachConsole(<wrapper pid>), SetConsoleCtrlHandler(null, true), GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(0, 0); bounded WaitForExit; taskkill /T /F of its OWN child only on timeout (global rail: kill only PIDs you started).
  - Assert seat-stop follows seat-job in the stub log.
- **V5 (DoD 5).** A claim whose workspace is shared: m3's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED line, no seat-job in the stub log, and seat-stop still recorded.
- **V6 (DoD 5).** MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH is ignored under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1. Use m3's method.
  - Prefer a behavioral proof that never reaches real Multipass: run a COPY of moe-agent.ps1 in a temp install dir whose own local-runner\agent-seat.mjs is a second, 'shipped' stub, inside postflight.ps1's [protected runtime] fixture shape. Then assert the shipped stub ran and the seam stub did not.
  - NEVER let a test run the real agent-seat.mjs seat-start: it can provision a real VM on a host with Multipass.
- **Error handling in the harness.** Every row restores the env it sets in finally, and bounds every wait. It never prints a line starting with SKIP.
- Run the new rows once on today's n1/n2 wrapper: they must FAIL (n1's placeholder refuses before any seat call).

implementationPlan.description:
Seat route, part 1, in scripts/moe-agent.ps1 (Edit tool only; keep the UTF-8 BOM, ASCII only). Port m3's code verbatim: strings, order and seam. Every function carries a `Twin: <m3 function>` comment.

**SEAM.** A resolver returns MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH when it is set AND not `$script:MoeRuntimeProtected`; otherwise the shipped path m3 uses, e.g. `Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'local-runner\agent-seat.mjs'`. The variable is read nowhere else.

**PLACEHOLDER.** Replace CQ-M07n1's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_VM_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE refusal with the seat route: when the gate sees verified-local and ready, this iteration is a VM-route iteration. The CLI, shared-mode and not-ready refusals stay exactly as n1 landed them.

**SEAT START.** Once per wrapper pass, before the iteration's claim, when `$script:MoeSeatInstance` (or m3's twin name) is empty:
- `& node $seat seat-start --project $projectPath --worker $WorkerId --runner $script:MoeProcessStartedAt --host $script:MoeHost`, with each value ONE array element. The runner token may contain spaces.
- Relax $ErrorActionPreference to 'Continue' around the native call, so 5.1 stderr ErrorRecords cannot throw.
- Parse the ONE JSON line.
- ok: keep the instance for the whole pass.
- Anything else (exit 1, 2 or 75; no line; bad JSON; an empty runner identity): m3's MOE_SEAT_START_FAILED line, then `exit 1`. That is fail closed and never the host CLI; CQ-M07n adds the capacity wait.
- Spawn it with the four credential variables removed (see step 3's helper).

**CLAIM MARKER.** On VM-route iterations only, build a per-iteration COPY, `$iterClaimArgs = $claimRpcArgs.PSObject.Copy()`, then `Add-Member -NotePropertyName executionRoute -NotePropertyValue 'vm'`. Use it at BOTH claim sites: the pre-flight claim (~7787) and the single-shot wait's re-claims (~7872). Never mutate $claimRpcArgs, so a legacy iteration never carries the key.

**POST-CLAIM BACKSTOP.** After the claim's workspace is resolved, on a VM-route iteration with a task bound: if `$script:MoeWtMode -cne 'worktree'`, refuse with m3's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED line and m3's exit path (report_blocked or not, as m3 does) before any job.

**Error handling.** Every native call checks $LASTEXITCODE and its parsed JSON explicitly. A failure under the VM route always ends in m3's code plus exit 1, never in a host launch.

amendments.description:
Seat route, part 1, in scripts/moe-agent.ps1. Edit with the Edit tool only; keep the UTF-8 BOM; ASCII only. Port m3's block and main-loop route verbatim; every function carries a `Twin: <m3 function>` comment.

**STARTUP**, the twin of m3's 'Verified-local seat VM (CQ-M07m3)' block. Place it after the ps1 account-rotation block that defines $accountHelper.
- `$script:AgentSeatCli = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'local-runner\agent-seat.mjs'`. MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH replaces it only when `-not $script:MoeRuntimeProtected`.
  - When protected and MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH is set, print m3's `[WARN] MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SEAT_PATH_IGNORED: ...` line once, never the value.
  - The variable is read nowhere else.
- `$script:SeatVmInstance = ''`, kept across iterations and tasks.
- **Invoke-MoeSeatCli**, the twin of seat_cli.
  - It saves and removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY and CODEX_API_KEY, runs `& node $script:AgentSeatCli @SeatArgs` with $ErrorActionPreference 'Continue', and restores all five in a finally. The in-process supervisor keeps env across passes, so a missed restore would leak.
  - An optional -InputText pipes stdin (step 3).
  - It captures stdout only and leaves stderr unredirected, so 5.1 makes no ErrorRecords.
- **Start-MoeSeatVm**, the twin of seat_vm_start.
  - Call `seat-start --project $projectPath --worker $WorkerId --runner $script:MoeProcessStartedAt --host $script:MoeHost`, with each value ONE array element; the runner token may hold spaces.
  - ok means exit 0, ok:true, and an instance that `-cmatch '^moe-vm-[0-9a-f]{20}$'`.
  - Wrap the capture and the instance assignment in `Set-MoeCtrlCDeferred $true` / `Set-MoeCtrlCDeferred $false` (~6307, the twin of wt_defer_signals/wt_release_signals). A Ctrl+C between a successful start and recording the instance then cannot orphan the VM.
  - On ok, print `[seat] started <instance>`.
  - Otherwise set $script:SeatStartCode to the line's code when it `-cmatch '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$'`, else to `exit <n>`; never stderr text. Return as m3 returns.
- **Stop-MoeSeatVm**, the twin of seat_vm_stop.
  - It is a no-op without an instance. Copy the instance, then clear $script:SeatVmInstance, before the call.
  - Run seat-stop through the scrub helper as an own child, with stdout to a private temp file, bounded at m3's 120 s (WaitForExit). Never kill it: m3 never signals the job.
  - Print `[seat] stopped <inst>` on ok; `[WARN] MOE_SEAT_STOP_FAILED: <code or exit n> instance=<inst>` on a failure; `[WARN] MOE_SEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT: instance=<inst>` past the bound.
  - It never throws.

**MAIN LOOP**, the twin of m3's step 2.
- Per-iteration reset, in the pre-flight reset block: `$script:MoeVmRoute = $false` and `$iterClaimArgs = $claimRpcArgs`, the same object on every non-VM iteration.
- Replace n1's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_VM_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE refusal with the route, in m3's order:
  1. $cliType codex: m3's `[ERROR] MOE_VM_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE: codex VM credentials are not wired yet; ...` line on stderr and exit 1, BEFORE seat-start and the claim.
  2. `$iterClaimArgs = $claimRpcArgs.PSObject.Copy()`, plus `Add-Member -NotePropertyName executionRoute -NotePropertyValue 'vm'`. If that throws: m3's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_CLAIM_UNBUILDABLE and exit 1. Never send an unmarked claim on this route.
  3. Turn the route flag on.
  4. With no instance held, run Start-MoeSeatVm. On anything but ok, 75 included: `[Console]::Error.WriteLine("[ERROR] MOE_SEAT_START_FAILED: $($script:SeatStartCode)")` and exit 1.
- Both claim sites, ~7787 (pre-flight) and ~7872 (single-shot re-claims), send $iterClaimArgs. Never mutate $claimRpcArgs.
- **Post-claim backstop, WORKER-ONLY.** Carry m3's comment: claimNextTask.ts openClaimAttempt derives worktree only for a WORKING task, so a QA claim of a REVIEW row always reads shared, and n1's pre-claim settings check covers QA.
  - Place it right after the worker's Initialize-MoeWorktree call (~8277), before the worktree pre-flight and the pre-flight landing.
  - Route on, Role worker, a bound task, and `$script:MoeWtMode -cne 'worktree'` → m3's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED line on stderr, then exit 1.
- **Taskless launch decision**, after the existing skip-launch block. Route on, no task bound, while the existing logic would still launch (a chat-only session or a launch probe) → skip the launch, clear the probe, and print m3's `MOE_TASKLESS_NO_LAUNCH reason=vm-route role=<r> worker=<w> - ...` line. The existing reasons stay byte-identical.
- New codes go only in MOE_SEAT_, MOE_VM_ and MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_, plus the new MOE_TASKLESS_NO_LAUNCH reason. Never use a compared parity family.

**Error handling.** Every native call checks its exit code and parsed JSON explicitly. A failure under the VM route ends in m3's code plus exit 1, never in a host launch.

It refuses codex BEFORE seat-start and the claim, adds MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_CLAIM_UNBUILDABLE, makes the backstop worker-only, and skips taskless host launches with reason=vm-route.

implementationPlan.description:
Seat route, part 2, in scripts/moe-agent.ps1: the job and the stop. Port m3 verbatim.

**ENV SCRUB HELPER.** Every seat-* spawn (start, job, stop) runs with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY and CODEX_API_KEY removed from $env:, each saved and restored in a finally. The in-process hot-reload supervisor keeps env across passes, so a missed restore would leak into the next pass.

**JOB BRANCH.** A new first branch of the launch dispatch, before codex/gemini/grok/claude (~8362), taken on VM-route iterations. It replaces the host CLI.
- **Credential.**
  - claude: lease as m3 does, then `$token = Invoke-MoeAccountHelper -HelperArgs @('vm-credential', $script:AccountLeasedId)`. $null on any non-zero exit means fail closed with m3's line.
  - codex: fail closed with m3's line; CQ-M07n adds the keys.
  - `$json = @{ name = <m3's name>; value = $token } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`.
  - The token lives only in these variables. It never enters an argv, an env, a file, Write-Host or a transcript line (task rail). Clear the variables right after the spawn.
- **Spawn.** `$json | & node $seat seat-job <m3's argv, each value one element>`.
  - --attempt `$script:MoeAttemptId`, --generation `$script:MoeAttemptGeneration`, --checkout `$script:MoeWtPath`, --task `$preflightTaskId`, --role `$Role`, --cli claude.
  - --commit: a worker sends W's HEAD (`Invoke-MoeGit -Top $script:MoeWtPath -GitArgs @('rev-parse','HEAD')`); QA sends the task's last landed completion commit, taken from where m3 takes it.
  - If any value is missing, fail closed with m3's code.
- **Stdin.** PowerShell's pipe appends CRLF, and 5.1's $OutputEncoding is ASCII (fine for sk-ant-oat tokens). Read M07j's landed stdin reader. If it JSON.parses the whole buffer, trailing whitespace is accepted. If it rejects trailing bytes, write stdin through System.Diagnostics.Process with RedirectStandardInput, no newline, then close it.
- **Relay and outcome.**
  - Use `2>&1 | ForEach-Object { ... }` with $ErrorActionPreference 'Continue'.
  - Write an [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord] to stderr as text. Never parse it as an outcome.
  - Relay each stdout string as the sh relays it, keeping the LAST stdout line that parses as JSON with `seatJob` -eq 1 (-is [int] or [long]).
  - ok:true sets `$script:CliExitCode` from its exitCode.
  - A missing outcome or ok:false takes m3's happy-path handling (a non-zero CliExitCode); CQ-M07n owns the failed-job detail.
  - Usage receipts and stream parsing behave as m3's do.
- **Landing.** For a worker with ok:true, call `Invoke-MoeVmCandidateLanding -Commit $o.commit -BaseTree $o.baseTree -Tree $o.tree -M @{ TaskId; Title; Status; ReopenCount; CliExit; Sid = $moeSid }`, mapped as m3 maps land_vm_candidate. Then fall through to the normal post-flight. QA lands nothing of its own.

**SEAT STOP.** In the outer finally (~9700), before Invoke-MoeDeregister, when the seat holds an instance:
- `seat-stop ... --instance <it>`, best-effort and bounded as m3 bounds it (e.g. Start-Process -PassThru + WaitForExit(<m3's limit>) + taskkill of that own PID on timeout), with the scrub helper. Then clear the instance.
- That one funnel covers normal exit, Ctrl+C, terminating errors, `exit` and the hot-reload hand-over. CQ-M07n moves the reload-branch stop ahead of its early deregister.

**Error handling.** Every native call checks its exit code and parsed JSON. Failures under the VM route end in m3's codes, never a host launch; seat-stop failures only warn.

**Done when** the step-1 rows pass alone on powershell.exe and pwsh.exe from WSL (mem:gotcha-pwsh7-reachable-from-wsl), and `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` passes (BOM intact).

amendments.description:
Seat route, part 2, in scripts/moe-agent.ps1: the job and the stop wiring. These are the twins of run_vm_job and seat_credential_json. Port m3 verbatim.

**JOB BRANCH.** A new first branch of the launch dispatch, right after the skip-launch branch and before codex (~8362): on the route, call Invoke-MoeVmJob.
- Nothing on this route runs the host CLI (Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand) or falls back to it.
- The steps around the dispatch stay as m3 keeps them: the claude lease, the prompt-cache check, the git guard, the launch timestamps, the heartbeat sidecar, the launch classification and the post-flight.

**Invoke-MoeVmJob**, in m3's order:
1. **Credential.** $script:AccountLeasedId is set, and `Invoke-MoeAccountHelper -HelperArgs @('vm-credential', $script:AccountLeasedId)` returns non-null. Otherwise print m3's `[ERROR] MOE_VM_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE: account <id|none> has no VM token; ...` and exit 1.
   - There is no vm-credential seam: the rows serve the canary from a temp token store through MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE.
2. **Inputs.** If one is missing, print m3's `[ERROR] MOE_SEAT_JOB_INPUT_MISSING: <attempt identity|worktree HEAD|landed completion commit>` and exit 1.
   - $script:MoeAttemptId and $script:MoeAttemptGeneration.
   - worker: checkout is $script:MoeWtPath; commit is `Invoke-MoeGit -Top $script:MoeWtPath -GitArgs @('rev-parse','--verify','HEAD^{commit}')`.
   - qa: checkout is $projectPath; commit is the pre-flight context's task.landing.lastCompletion.sha.
   - The commit must `-cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$'`.
3. **The job.**
   - Print m3's `[seat] job role=<r> task=<id> instance=<i> commit=<c>`.
   - Build ONE JSON string, `[ordered]@{ name = 'CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN'; value = $token } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`, and pipe it to seat-job's stdin through Invoke-MoeSeatCli -InputText, with m3's exact argv, each value one element.
   - Clear $token and $json in a finally. They never reach an argv, an env, a file, Write-Host or an exception message; never interpolate them into a thrown string.
   - **Stdin.** PowerShell's pipe appends CRLF, and 5.1's $OutputEncoding is ASCII. Read M07j's landed stdin reader. If it JSON.parses the whole buffer, trailing whitespace is accepted. If not, write stdin through System.Diagnostics.Process with RedirectStandardInput, no newline, then close it.
   - **Relay.** Capture and relay each stdout line. stderr is left unredirected, so it goes straight to the wrapper's stderr and is never parsed.
4. **Failures.**
   - vm-credential or JSON building failed: MOE_VM_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE, as in 1.
   - The outcome is the LAST stdout line that is a JSON object with seatJob -eq 1.
   - A failed job is any of: seat-job exit != 0; no marked line; ok not a [bool] $true; role -cne $Role; commit -cne the commit passed in. Print m3's `[ERROR] MOE_SEAT_JOB_FAILED: <the line's fixed code, or exit n>` and exit 1. CQ-M07n refines this.
5. **ok.**
   - `$script:CliExitCode` is the outcome's exitCode when it is an integer 0-255, else 1.
   - worker: call `Invoke-MoeVmCandidateLanding -Commit $o.commit -BaseTree $o.baseTree -Tree $o.tree -M @{ TaskId; Title; Status; ReopenCount; CliExit; Sid = $moeSid }`, mapped as m3 maps land_vm_candidate, whatever settings.autoCommit says. The admitted tree is the job's only copy, and the helper moves only the task branch and W.
   - A non-zero .Rc means exit 1 and land nothing else; the helper already printed its MOE_VM_CANDIDATE_* line.
   - qa: nothing lands.
6. Then the normal post-flight.

**SEAT STOP WIRING.** In the outer finally (~9700), call Stop-MoeSeatVm right before Invoke-MoeDeregister. The pass's finally covers normal exit, Ctrl+C, terminating errors and `exit`. The hot-reload branch's early `Invoke-MoeDeregister -Reason wrapper_restart` belongs to CQ-M07n and is already in its plan: stop before that deregister there.

**Error handling.** Every failure under the VM route prints one fixed code on stderr, never a token, a path value or child stderr. It exits 1 before anything lands; the finally then stops the VM and deregisters. Nothing falls through to the host CLI.

**Done when** the step-1 rows pass alone under powershell.exe and pwsh.exe from WSL (mem:gotcha-pwsh7-reachable-from-wsl), and `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` passes, BOM intact.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Under a well-formed verified-local and ready answer, a worker or QA seat of moe-agent.ps1 never runs its agent CLI on the host. Once per wrapper pass, before the claim, it starts one seat VM. It claims with executionRoute 'vm', and refuses a claim whose workspace is not worktree. It runs each task as a seat-job, sending the leased account's VM token only on stdin, and lands a worker's admitted tree through Invoke-MoeVmCandidateLanding. It stops the VM in the outer finally on every exit. Strings, order and the MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH seam are CQ-M07m3's.
acceptanceCriteria: V1: the host CLI fake never runs; the agent-seat stub records seat-start, seat-job and seat-stop in that order; every claim carries executionRoute 'vm'.
V2: the admitted tree becomes one commit on moe/task/<id> through Invoke-MoeVmCandidateLanding.
V3: the canary token reaches seat-job only on stdin; it is absent from every argv, env, output and file except the token store, on 5.1 and 7.
V4: seat-stop runs on a normal exit and on Ctrl+C sent mid-job with GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent.
V5/V6: a shared claim refuses MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED with no seat-job; MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH is ignored under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1.
The vm-route rows pass alone on both engines; postflight.ps1 passes on 5.1; parity-check passes; the BOM is kept.
invariants: No host agent-CLI launch on any VM-route path; every failure is fail-closed with m3's code.
